title: Who maintains Tracker records and landmark Wiki pages, and when?
question: Who maintains Tracker records and landmark Wiki pages, and when?
answer:
LD-20: The grilling primitive stays unaware of landmarks and the Tracker; compound workflow activity owns reading and updating the landmark system. The grilling skill rebuild is untouched.
LD-21: Tracker updates follow workflow events and ongoing alignment, deriving its view from source artifacts wherever possible. Wiki creation/update uses normal Spec/Task delivery during building; planning/review are also opportunities for Wiki reconciliation. No separate publishing ceremony.
